section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the participants and procedures for a single study examining body-related attitudes in women. The final sample consisted of 263 women (221 from Amazon's Mechanical Turk and 42 from a liberal arts college), with a mean age of 35.26 years and mean BMI of 26.23. Participants completed an online survey via SurveyMonkey that assessed positive psychological constructs including body-related attitudes, with measures presented in random order.
